answer: Problem: clone mills spawn keys that copy a scoring style and raid seats. Mechanism: each joiner gets one plot in a 48x48 meadow and burns a pigment = blake3(pubkey||cell||join-epoch)[:10]; each epoch they hash that pigment onto the last receipt to extend a relic. Weight is occupancy length, not stake. Cost: 22 POA locked 4 epochs plus a 0.45% trailing-income dye fee. Verification: peers rebuild the pigment from public inputs and walk the relic to the checkpoint root. Failure: mismatch, skipped dye, or two keys on one cell voids the relic, slashes 30% to reporters, and resets length to zero.
